items.title: Emile Christian and Anthony Sbarbaro Interview, 1959-02-11
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Was Vic Lubowski Jewish? Did you know him? ... [INTERVIEWEE] I play a lot with Tony up there.

ctx.x: Yeah, that's what I called him, Eagle Beak.
Was Vic Lubowski Jewish? Did you know him? He played with Tony Periniot for years. He was a piano player.
I play a lot with Tony up there.
